    • OK_SKIP_CURSOR_MOVE

      public static final String OK_SKIP_CURSOR_MOVE
      Following could be used by spinner as event's command to indicate that if already on the row don't need to do "rs.absolute()". But that might be the default behavior anyway, in which case this would be a no-op.
